result.topic_en: Logarithmic recomputation of worked examples of a crown-glass lens, a flint-glass lens and their two-lens combination, giving focal lengths, 'Verlust' (loss) values and the positions of the principal points, then repeating the crown and flint calculations with altered refractive indices.

methods.what: Logarithmic computation of the focal length of a thick crown-glass lens from its radii, index and thickness
Computation of a 'Verlust' (loss) quantity for each lens as the difference of logarithmic terms
Combination of two lenses, f and f', to obtain the focal length of the compound objective and the total loss
Location of the principal points (Mittelpunkte) of the whole objective, measured from the front and rear surfaces
Recomputation of the crown-glass lens with a changed refractive index
Recomputation of the flint-glass lens with a changed refractive index
